## Review checklist

- [ ] Public API, document format and history compatibility considered.
- [ ] Relevant regression checks passed.
- [ ] Documentation/examples updated where needed.
- [ ] User-visible changes recorded in CHANGELOG.md.
- [ ] Generated files and private data excluded.
